pictures.scene: Asher Brown Durand, The Beeches — the tall beeches standing over the shepherd and his flock in the evening light, let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice
pictures.name: pd_durand_bomen

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Seal Rock — the green wave breaking white over the rock with the sea lions and the gulls, let the sea resound and all that fills it
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_zee

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, Green Wheat Fields, Auvers — the young wheat running in waves with yellow flowers under a swirling sky, let the fields exult and all that is in them
pictures.name: pd_vangogh_velden

pictures.scene: Lucas Cranach the Elder, The Sermon of Saint John the Baptist — the Baptist preaching from the tree stump to the crowd in the wood, then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD
pictures.name: pd_cranach_juichen

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, The Last Judgment — Christ enthroned under the cross with Mary and the Baptist and the ranks of the saints while Michael stands over the rising dead, for He is coming, He is coming to judge the earth
pictures.name: pd_eyck_oordeel

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Numbering at Bethlehem — the whole village crowding to be counted in the snow under the red winter sun, He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_volkeren

lines.text: and all that is in them.
Then all the trees of the forest
will sing for joy before the LORD,
He is coming to judge the earth.
He will judge the world in righteousness
and the peoples in His faithfulness.
